name: pinga
description: Pinga: office attendance and field sales visits.

scripts.test: node scripts/stamp.js --check && npm run test:unit && npm run test:db && npm run test:screens && npm run size
scripts.deploy:staging: env -u SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --no-warnings scripts/deploy.js staging && npm run test:staging
scripts.deploy:live: env -u SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --no-warnings scripts/deploy.js live
scripts.test:staging: env -u SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --no-warnings tests/staging/rules.js && env -u SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --no-warnings tests/staging/journey.js && env -u SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 node --no-warnings tests/staging/browser.js
